package.description: Free your AI gimbal webcam from its vendor software.

en-US.description: Free your AI gimbal webcam from its vendor software.
en-US.longDescription: Aperio is a lightweight background daemon that replaces the vendor companion app for AI motorized-gimbal webcams. It automatically aims the camera at a saved startup position and enables AI tracking whenever an application opens the camera — no vendor software, no telemetry, no background bloat.
en-US.name: Aperio
